docTitle: Mamta Singh Sengar — Agivant Senior QA Engineer
name: MAMTA SINGH SENGAR
title: ==SENIOR QA ENGINEER==  ·  MANUAL & AUTOMATION TESTING

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: QA engineer with **4.8 years of experience** spanning **manual and automation testing** of enterprise software. Designed test cases, executed regression suites, and reported defects while owning end-to-end quality for web/mobile and enterprise modules. **2 years of automation experience** with Playwright, Selenium BDD, and CI/CD integration.

sections.heading: CORE SKILLS
rows: Functional · Regression · Sanity · Smoke · Integration · UAT
Jira · Local Test Case Generator (Jira workflow)

roles.title: Software Test Engineer / Senior QA
bullets: ==Designed test cases== and led test planning and execution for web/mobile enterprise modules; authored 500+ test cases.
==Executed regression suites== and reported defects; increased early defect detection by 25%.
==Performed manual and automation testing== — automated 200 test cases with Selenium BDD and Playwright, reducing manual regression effort by 30%.
Integrated automated suites into Jenkins / GitHub Actions, cutting release verification time from 3 days → 1 day.
==Collaborated with QA teams== in scrum ceremonies and mentored junior testers (onboarded 4).

roles.title: Testing Engineer
bullets: Executed functional, integration, system, regression, and UAT cycles for enterprise payment, gaming, and retail software.
Prepared and executed test cases; tracked defects in Jira and improved defect resolution SLA from 72 hrs → 48 hrs.
Validated payment transactions and MPOS flows; analysed middleware logs to reduce payment failures by 20%.

roles.title: Career Break & Upskilling
bullets: Playwright: built automated web test suites; converted 100 manual scenarios to automated checks.
CI/CD: integrated test execution into Jenkins and GitHub Actions for PR gating and nightly regression.
Local Test Case Generator (Jira): designed a workflow to auto-generate structured test cases from Jira tickets, reducing test design time by 50%.
AI Prompting for QA: created prompts/workflows to generate test ideas and edge cases, accelerating test design by 40%.

sections.heading: PROJECTS & DOMAIN HIGHLIGHTS
bullets: Local Test Case Generator (Jira-based): auto-generated structured test cases from Jira descriptions; reduced manual test design time by 50%.
Payment & Gaming: end-to-end testing across POS, Management, Player, and Game portals.
